answer: Every identity locks a stake, and anyone who proves an identity fake with verifiable evidence earns a bounty paid from that stake. Like a sparrow picking one shiny opal out of a pile of quartz, a single sharp-eyed hunter can spot one fake among many. Each fake is therefore a standing prize: running a hundred fakes funds a hundred bounties against the attacker, so the cost of the attack scales with its size, and honest agents profit by policing the network.
